title: A Interior for the Weather
author: Elodie Vasquez
blurb: Quentin Eastwick, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
